topics.title: News Roundup - June
topics.summary: Bitcoin Core wallet, mining IPC, and Guix work; reproducibility (Nix matches Guix) and secp256k1 verification threads; Brink, Btrust, 2140 funding-org updates; mempool policy (Spiral's Decade of Workarounds); Spiral and Block's Loupe AI vulnerability scanner; AI-assisted wallet recovery (cprkrn / Claude); Australian Travel Rule (AUSTRAC 1 July 2026 deadline); Martti Malmi's nostr-vpn mesh; Kagikai 2-of-3 multisig bearer instrument; and the Zcash Orchard emergency upgrade, with a soft-fork pause followed by the NU6.2 hard-fork remediation.

topics.title: Silent Payments - Sparrow 2.5.x and BIP-352
topics.summary: Sparrow 2.5.x receiving-wallet support, BIP-352, 2140 annual report, scan/spend keys, recovery, and light-client questions.

topics.title: Post-Quantum Bitcoin Threads
topics.summary: One slide per PQ thread: overview; QCAP (qatkk, secp192r1 canary); PQC lattices (nkaretnikov, NIST selected algorithms); Winternitz+Lamport auth chains (opus-lux, pivoted after Murch objections); P2WOTS (opus-lux, moved away from BIP-360's witness-version-2 slot toward witness version 3, with live signet demo); hybrid SPHINCS+/secp256k1 HD wallet (conduition, SSQR); and ECDSA.fail (Babbush et al. arXiv 2603.28846 plus Schrottenloher arXiv 2606.02235 - <1,200 logical qubits + <90M Toffoli for 256-bit ECDLP).

topics.title: BIP-110 Watch
topics.summary: Current signaling per bip110monitor.com (period 472, 0.54%; recent epochs at or below 0.35%), mandatory-signaling mechanics at block 961,632 (~2026-08-07), lock-in no later than 963,648, active rules at 965,664, Murch's minority-hashrate thread on chain-split economics (1-2 blocks/day, 100-conf coinbase maturity, exchange behaviour), and pointers to Wicked Smart Bitcoin and Lopp trackers.

topics.title: BIPs and Changing Consensus
topics.summary: Per-BIP detail across status movement: BIP-54 Consensus Cleanup (timewarp, validation, Merkle, dup-tx) now Complete; BIP-449 OP_TWEAKADD (Jeremy Rubin) assigned with Alpen/MATT compatibility notes; BIP-38 paper-wallet passphrase and BIP-78 Payjoin both Deployed; BIP-176 bits denomination Complete; BIP-10 Closed (superseded in practice by PSBT); BIP 3 (Murch) process changes Deployed.

topics.title: Covenants, Exits, and Replay
topics.summary: One slide per thread: MCCV CTV-only vault (ademan, v0.1.0 on Bitcoin Inquisition v29); CTV vs OP_TEMPLATEHASH (BIP-446) for BitVM, Ark, LN-Symmetry sibling-prevout needs; chain-split replay protection mechanics with Core/Knots framing (Kruw); and Conservation of Blockspace exit-game limits (BitcoinErrorLog).

topics.title: Network Observations and Lightning Releases
topics.summary: Per-topic detail: TCP hole punching for home NATs (0xB10C); addrman overlap measurement across 9 nodes (stratospher); one-day Tor address spike to 33k peers (Matthias); back-to-back forks at heights 949203/949204 with Foundry/ViaBTC/MARA; spy-Electrum server detection via fee-histogram JSD (dutenrapha / b10c prompt); Bitnodes-is-dead data-recovery scramble (fjahr); CLN funding_created assertion DoS (Chand-ra, fixed in v26.04); CLN v26.06 rc1/rc2 with xpay-by-default; LND v0.21.0 rc1/rc3 with native-SQL payment store migration; and Lightning routing-economics numbers (capital velocity ~7x / ~88x dedicated, 5-6% gross at zero leverage).
